comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' brief return...

Stats:

Durability: 60
Defense: 50
Swordplay +2
Sword Mastery +1
Rowing +1
Unisex; 50k fame to equip.

This armor can only be made with a special Relic item, Coat of the Nemean Lion, which is obtained from Atlantis while it is present. Transmuation Alchemy is also required to complete the upgrade into this armor.

Note that the Relic item (Coat of the Nemean Lion) can only be obtained from Atlantis' dungeon via the Myth and Reality TH; if Atlantis is gone, then the TH vanishes, cannot be run, and you're stuck until it returns before you can get the Relic item needed. More details on the TH at its relic item page. Now, the listed J-Wiki ingredients are:

Plate Armour (base item for TA)
Suede x30
Coat of the Nemean Lion x1
Alchemist's Tarot x10

Whether or not that is actually the case, I don't know; never did get around to having one made back on GAMA. Regardless, it can be enhanced to EX form via Transmutation Alchemy once more if one is so inclined. The EX effect is: Increase Melee Capabilities R2

Pairs nicely with the General's Helm too, I recall. That's always available, unlike the relic item/armor and Atlantis, so I'll let someone else have the honor of covering that particular piece of equipment's details. Well then... cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Forgot to mention: R10 Casting/Alchemy required for this item's production as well.

Oh, and be sure to use Wingless/Ouroboros books as the Lion item is considered part of the materials and will be lost if production isn't successful. Atlantis isn't always around, so you'd be sad if you lost this hard to obtain item.
